purpose: Request an explicit decision for a consequential action without treating dismissal as confirmation.
avoid: Avoid routine information in an interrupting confirmation.
basis: Native source page 72:2675 (Alert Dialog), observed anatomy and examples.
profileRationale: The family presents controls or navigation; static depictions do not establish an interactive contract.
sourceRule: The pinned AlertDialogAction is an ordinary Button, not a Close wrapper. Its onClick invokes the caller action and does not automatically close the alert dialog. AlertDialogCancel wraps the primitive Close. The caller explicitly closes after successful work when desired; cancellation never emits a destructive confirmation.
keyboardAndFocus: The alert dialog is modal. This reference chooses Cancel as initialFocus using the actual Popup prop. Tab remains inside; Escape/Cancel dismiss without confirming and return focus. Outside press is ignored by the primitive.
referenceDecisions: One stable trigger/content ownership relation per shown instance; concrete labels and task children are caller supplied. Exact wrapper types retain optional handles/payloads/placement overrides. Complete describes this sufficient reference, not a full application/platform certification.
